Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614458', join activities on assay_id, join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter for exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
